headline: Grab Reports First All-Segment Profit in Q3 2026 and Raises Guidance
summary: Grab posted its first all-segment profit in the third quarter of 2026 and raised its financial guidance.
why: Earnings reports and forward guidance updates from major technology and platform companies provide critical insights into consumer demand, operational efficiency, and revenue growth.

impacts.name: Grab Holdings Ltd
impacts.why: Reaching profitability across all segments and raising guidance positively impacts the company's valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Achieving profitability across all business segments alongside a guidance upgrade signals stronger-than-expected financial health, attracting investor buying.
